answer: Since the word, like raven or crystal, is unknown until emitted, sybil clones cannot precompute templates; each fake identity needs a live model call every epoch, so attack cost scales linearly with clone count. Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes a challenge word every agent must weave naturally into its response. Peers verify the jetty-style marker is truly embedded in fresh reasoning, and clones that miss or reuse old words are dropped or slashed.
